allow: PowerShell(if \(Test-Path ~/.claude/skills\) { Get-ChildItem -Path ~/.claude/skills -Recurse -Include "SKILL.md","skill.md" | Select-Object Name, Directory, @{Name="Size";Expression={$_.Length}} } else { "no-skills-dir" })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path ~/.claude/settings.json\) { try { Get-Content -Raw ~/.claude/settings.json | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null; "valid" } catch { "parse-error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } else { "not-found" })
PowerShell(if \(Test-Path ~/.claude.json\) { try { Get-Content -Raw ~/.claude.json | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null; "valid" } catch { "parse-error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } else { "not-found" })
